description_en: Creates a defense rule against brute-force attacks
name: CreateAntiBruteForceRule

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The name of the defense rule
parameters.help_zh: 防暴力破解规则的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The maximum period of time during which failed logon attempts from an account can occur. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

1
2
5
10
15

To configure a defense rule, you must specify the Span, FailCount, and ForbiddenTime parameters. If the number of failed logon attempts from an account within the minutes specified by Span exceeds the value specified by FailCount, the account cannot be used for logons within the minutes specified by ForbiddenTime
parameters.help_zh:
设置账号登录失败的时间的阈值，单位为分钟。取值：

1：1分钟
2：2分钟
5：5分钟
10：10分钟
15：15分钟

Span、FailCount、ForbiddenTime这三个参数组合成一个防暴力破解规则，表示XX分钟内账号登录失败超过XX次，该账号禁止登录XX分钟
parameters.name: span

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of failed logon attempts from an account. Valid values: 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 50, 80, and 100
parameters.help_zh: 设置账号登录失败次数的阈值。单位为次。取值：2、3、4、5、10、50、80、100
parameters.name: fail_count

parameters.help_en:
The period of time during which logons from an account are not allowed. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

5
15
30
60
120
360
720
1440
10080
52560000: permanent
parameters.name: forbidden_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to set the defense rule as the default rule. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
防暴力破解规则是否设置为默认规则。取值：

true：是
false：否

资产不在其他规则时，会使用默认规则
parameters.name: default_rule

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers to which you want to apply the defense rule
parameters.help_zh: 防暴力破解规则生效的服务器的UUID列表
parameters.name: uuid_list

fields.help_en:
Whether to enable RDP interception, default is on. Values: 
on: Enable 
off: Disable
fields.help_zh:
是否开启RDP拦截方式，默认开启，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: rdp

fields.help_en:
Whether to enable the SqlServer interception method, default is off. Values: 
on: Enable 
off: Disable
fields.help_zh:
是否开启SqlServer拦截方式，默认关闭，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: sql_server

fields.help_en:
Whether to enable SSH interception, default is on. Values: 
on: Enable 
off: Disable
fields.help_zh:
是否开启SSH拦截方式，默认开启，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
fields.name: ssh

parameters.help_en: The types of protocols supported for interception by the brute force attack rule creation
parameters.help_zh: 暴力破解创建规则支持拦截的协议类型
parameters.name: protocol_type

CreateAntiBruteForceRule.description_en: The information about the defense rule
CreateAntiBruteForceRule.description_zh: 创建的防暴力破解规则的信息

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the defense rule

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
